format_strategy.telegram: Use the existing Telegram adapter to poll public channel pages, extract post text/link/timestamp, dedupe by URL and normalized text hash, then route to a scoring layer; for crypto, keep near-real-time polling for Cointelegraph and CryptoQuant.
format_strategy.substack: Use the newsletter scraper + readability-lxml on each post page, but prefer the Substack RSS/author page when available to detect new posts first, then fetch the article body only for fresh items.
format_strategy.rss: Use RSS as the canonical transport whenever possible; ingest feed items, store GUID/link/published_at, and only fetch full content for items that pass a relevance threshold.

quickest_win: Start with Cointelegraph Telegram first: it is the easiest high-cadence source to wire, and it gives immediate market-moving headlines before you add heavier signal-density sources like CryptoQuant.
round_3_prompt: Evaluate an end-to-end ranking/scoring design for mixed-source ingestion: how to combine Telegram headlines, on-chain alerts, and newsletter long-form posts into one unified signal score with dedupe, source weighting, and latency buckets.
